items.prompt: Which 3D shape has 5 faces, 8 edges and 5 vertices?
hints: Think about the base and the sloping faces.
Picture a pyramid with a square base.
Count 1 square face and 4 triangular faces.
items.explanation: A square-based pyramid has 1 square face and 4 triangle faces: 5 faces. It has 4 edges on the base and 4 edges up to the top: 8 edges. It has 4 base corners and 1 top: 5 vertices.

options.why: A triangular prism has 5 faces, but 9 edges and 6 vertices.
A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.
A triangular pyramid has 4 faces, 6 edges and 4 vertices.

items.prompt: A cube is made from wire edges. Each edge is 5 cm long. What is the total length of wire in the cube, in centimetres?
hints: All edges of a cube are the same length.
Multiply the number of edges by 5.
items.explanation: A cube has 12 edges. 12 × 5 = 60 cm of wire.

items.prompt: Which statement about a rhombus is true?
hints: Think about a square that has been pushed over.
Which sides are equal in a rhombus?
Which sides are parallel in a rhombus?
items.explanation: A rhombus has four equal sides and two pairs of parallel sides. Its angles do not have to be right angles and its diagonals are usually different lengths.

options.text: All four angles are right angles.
options.why: That describes a rectangle or square. A rhombus can be a squashed shape.

options.text: It has four equal sides and opposite sides are parallel.
Only one pair of sides is parallel.
options.why: That describes a trapezium. A rhombus has two pairs of parallel sides.

options.text: The diagonals are always the same length.
options.why: That is true for a rectangle. A rhombus can have one long and one short diagonal.

items.prompt: True or false: A cube has 12 edges.
hints: Count the top, bottom and side edges.
Each is a set of four.
items.explanation: A cube has 4 edges on top, 4 on the bottom and 4 going up the sides: 12 edges.

items.prompt: True or false: A square-based pyramid has 6 faces.
hints: Count the base and the sides.
items.explanation: It has 1 square base and 4 triangular faces, so 5 faces in total.
